astral_dice.guide.category.cards.desc: Cards come in battle cards and effect cards: battle cards slot into the dice card bar and occupy cost slots, granting points during the Blessing; effect cards have their own play count and cooldown.
Attack cards: consume one use when each blessing round starts and take effect, granting attack points in dice battles.
astral_dice.guide.category.cards_defense: Defense cards: consume one use when each blessing round starts and take effect, granting defense points in PvP dice battles.
Effect cards: grant various bonuses on use. Each play consumes one play count; once the play count is used up, the cards enter cooldown, and the play count is restored when the cooldown ends.
astral_dice.guide.category.chips.desc: Chips are passive accessories granting attack, defense, speed, health and resource bonuses.
astral_dice.guide.category.chips_healing: Chips tied to your healing state: they keep your health safe and grant offensive bonuses while your HP is plentiful.
astral_dice.guide.category.chips_mark.de: Chips tied to applying the Mark status, providing steady bonuses for focus-fire playstyles.
astral_dice.guide.category.chips_other.d: Chips that grant various other passives.
astral_dice.guide.category.chips_starlig: Chips tied to your Starlight resource, handy for earning Star Coin profit.
astral_dice.guide.category.dice.desc: The dice is the core equipment: while equipped, melee attacks apply the Dice Blessing to you. Different dice offer different card slot and chip slot counts; spend Star Coins on an anvil to star-up your dice and unlock more slots.
astral_dice.guide.category.getting_start: An accessory mod based on the Curios API. Equip dice, signs, chips and cards to gain buffs and combat abilities, and even pull off combo plays with your teammates.
astral_dice.guide.category.signs.desc: Signs grant character-flavored active and passive skills.
astral_dice.guide.entry.atm_chip.1: Gain 1 Starlight on equip; converting Starlight to Star Coins yields 40%% more.
astral_dice.guide.entry.attack_card_char: Charge: fixed +5 attack power during the Dice Blessing; returns Full Power when the blessing ends.
astral_dice.guide.entry.attack_card_epic: Attack Card (XL): grants 1~10 attack power in dice battles.
astral_dice.guide.entry.attack_card_full: Full Power: +6 attack power, and this strike's final attack power is +50%%.
astral_dice.guide.entry.attack_card_larg: Attack Card (Large): grants 1~6 attack power in dice battles.
astral_dice.guide.entry.attack_card_medi: Attack Card (Medium): grants 1~3 attack power in dice battles.
astral_dice.guide.entry.attack_card_meit: Meito: grants 1~20 attack in dice battles.
astral_dice.guide.entry.attack_card_shad: Shadow Strike: fixed +3 attack power, and applies Darkness (0:03) to the target.
astral_dice.guide.entry.bank_card_high_c: Provides 7 base Starlight while equipped (removed on unequip).
astral_dice.guide.entry.bank_card_low_ch: Provides 4 base Starlight while equipped (removed on unequip).
astral_dice.guide.entry.bank_card_unlimi: Gain 3 Starlight on equip; after each Dice Blessing ends, you and all team members gain 3 Star Coins.
astral_dice.guide.entry.battle_dice.1: With a dice equipped, melee attacks apply the Dice Blessing to you; attacks made under the Blessing enter an attack-versus-defense dice battle. The attacker's roll and card bonuses count toward attack; the defender rolls a defense dice toward defense, and final damage = attack − defense (minimum 1).
astral_dice.guide.entry.battle_dice.2: Monsters and players share the same defense formula: defense = 2 + armor÷2 + 1.4×toughness + defense dice + bonuses (1 defense = 2 armor); players roll their defense dice only during a Blessing.
astral_dice.guide.entry.battle_dice.3: Upgrade a die on the anvil with Star Coins to raise its star level for stronger blessings; the base → golden → diamond → netherite chain unlocks more card and chip slots.
astral_dice.guide.entry.battle_dice.name: Battle Dice Rolls
astral_dice.guide.entry.bonnie_sign.1: Active Skill - Undercover Action: the first target of your next attack gains Undercover Investigation (permanent until death or disappearance); if the target is marked, gain Star Coins equal to mark layers ×2.
astral_dice.guide.entry.bonnie_sign.2: Passive Skill - Key Clue: +3 attack against marked targets; killing a marked hostile with more than 20 HP grants a random battle card; killing an Undercover Investigation target triggers the Investigation event.
astral_dice.guide.entry.bonnie_sign.3: Investigation event (4 stages): I — you and the applier gain Invisibility (0:15); II — Invisibility + +2 vs non-boss hostiles (0:20); III — Invisibility + +(2+mark layers) vs non-boss hostiles (0:30); Truth revealed — you, the applier and your team gain Invisibility, +(2+marks) vs non-boss and +(2+marks×2) vs bosses (1:00). While hidden during an Investigation stage (Invisibility + Investigation Stage), you cannot be targeted by mobs.
astral_dice.guide.entry.buffer_shield_ch: When damaged, gain 2 healing points and 3 Star Coins, once per 15 seconds.
astral_dice.guide.entry.candy_chip.1: Each time you use an effect card, gain 1 healing point and restore 1 HP; at full HP, this round's play count +1 (once per round).
astral_dice.guide.entry.cursed_sword_chi: Always affected by the Blue Curse while equipped: armor -20%%, armor toughness -100%% (armor rounded down).
During a Dice Blessing, killing a hostile with more than 20 HP grants +1 attack (at most 1 per blessing), up to a cap; removing the chip clears all bonuses and the Blue Curse.
Enigmatic Legacy+ link: while equipped, the Scroll of a Thousand Curses' curse count +1.
astral_dice.guide.entry.cutter_blade_chi: At or above 60%% max HP: attack +4 plus your current healing points as attack.
astral_dice.guide.entry.cutter_chip.1: At or above 60%% max HP: attack +2 plus your current healing points as attack.
astral_dice.guide.entry.defense_card_epi: Defense Card (XL): grants 1~10 defense power in dice battles.
astral_dice.guide.entry.defense_card_lar: Defense Card (Large): grants 1~6 defense power in dice battles.
astral_dice.guide.entry.defense_card_med: Defense Card (Medium): grants 1~3 defense power in dice battles.
astral_dice.guide.entry.diamond_dice.1: Diamond die. Even more card and chip slots.
astral_dice.guide.entry.dice.1: The base die. While equipped, melee attacks trigger the Dice Blessing (gain it on attack, activate dice combat while blessed, press the key to open the card inventory).
astral_dice.guide.entry.eagle_scope_chip: On hit, apply 1 Mark layer; this combat, gain +2 attack per Mark layer on the target.
astral_dice.guide.entry.effect_card_bers: Berserk: +3 attack, take +1 damage from all sources, for 3:00.
astral_dice.guide.entry.effect_card_choc: Chocolate Cake: restores 20%% of max HP.
astral_dice.guide.entry.effect_card_dire: Directional Blast: +5 to all ranged/magic damage against hostiles, dealing the same damage to hostiles within 6 blocks of the target, for 1:00.
astral_dice.guide.entry.effect_card_expr: Express Delivery: usable on self or others (sneak+right-click). Grants Speed II (1:00).
astral_dice.guide.entry.effect_card_fate: Fate's Guide (exclusive, usable only by its owner):
Play count +1; instantly halve the current max active-skill cooldown countdown.
Deal 20%% more damage to targets with a Weak Mark for 5:00.
Saturation from all food is doubled for 5:00.
Enigmatic Legacy+ link: while wearing the Cursed Ring, correct Curse 1 — incoming doubled damage reduced by 50%% for 5:00.
Iron's Spells 'n Spellbooks link: spell mana costs halved for 5:00.
astral_dice.guide.entry.effect_card_figh: Fight Poison with Poison: gain Poison (0:08), then remove up to 3 vanilla negative effects and gain Regeneration II (0:30) (hidden icon).
astral_dice.guide.entry.effect_card_king: King Power: take 8 damage, gain +5 attack for 3:00.
astral_dice.guide.entry.effect_card_livi: Living Page (exclusive, usable only by its owner):
Play count +1; all ranged/magic damage against hostiles +1 (stacks with each use, cap 20), applying 1 Mark layer, for 1:00.
Additionally, using a Living Page while the Investigator sign is equipped permanently increases its damage by +1 (reset on unequip).
astral_dice.guide.entry.effect_card_luxu: Luxury Feast: usable on self or others (sneak+right-click a target player). Heals the target and all players within 6 blocks for 30%% of your max HP.
astral_dice.guide.entry.effect_card_mons: Monster Brick: +6 to all ranged/magic damage against hostiles for 1:00.
Monster Laser: +4 to all ranged/magic damage against hostiles for 1:00.
astral_dice.guide.entry.effect_card_orbi: Orbital Strike: +8 to all ranged/magic damage against hostiles for 1:00.
astral_dice.guide.entry.effect_card_unwa: Unwavering: armor +8 (equal to +4 defense in dice battles) and Resistance II for 3:00.
astral_dice.guide.entry.effect_card_you_: You Have, I Have: only usable on other players (right-click them). You and the target each gain a random card.
astral_dice.guide.entry.eight_sided_dice: When a Dice Blessing triggers, roll and accumulate; every 8 total points grant +1 Starlight (capped); rolling exactly 8 grants 8 Star Coins.
astral_dice.guide.entry.fanny_sign.1: Active Skill - Trouble Maker: immediately trigger one random event: gain Regeneration (0:30); gain Strength (0:30); gain an Attack Card (XL); gain a random effect card (excl. exclusive) + 3 Star Coins; gain Nourishment (2:00) and Saturation (0:30); gain Speed (0:30).
astral_dice.guide.entry.fanny_sign.2: (continued) suffer Instant Damage; gain Poison (0:15); gain Hunger (0:30) and Nausea (0:07); gain Wither (0:07) and Darkness (0:05); gain Weakness (0:15) and Mining Fatigue (0:30).
astral_dice.guide.entry.fanny_sign.3: Passive Skill - Spot the Highlight: after you trigger an event, gain 3 Star Coins.
astral_dice.guide.entry.fen_sign.1: Active Skill - Channel Qi: for 1:00, attack +3; with Recharged Energy, heal 6 HP and gain Speed (1:00); at 5 layers of Recharged Energy, consume 2, and during the next Dice Blessing apply 80%% of each attack's total damage to other hostiles within 6 blocks of the target (until that blessing ends).
astral_dice.guide.entry.fen_sign.2: Passive Skill - Recharged Energy: with Recharged Energy, attack +2 and armor +4; no Blessing triggered within 1:00 → Recharged Energy +1; triggering a Blessing → -1; using a healing effect card → +1.
Attacking a hostile target grants +1 Starlight (max 1 per target); every 4 Starlight grants +1 attack.
astral_dice.guide.entry.friendship_badge: When you apply any healing effect to a friendly player, both of you gain 2 healing points.
astral_dice.guide.entry.golden_dice.1: Golden die. Unlocks more card and chip slots than the base die.
astral_dice.guide.entry.golden_star_plat: A golden star plate for high-tier crafting; found in loot chests.
astral_dice.guide.entry.haiqing_sign.1: Active Skill - Weak Mark: the first target of your next attack gains a Weak Mark (5:00): takes 10%% more damage from any source and suffers Weakness.
astral_dice.guide.entry.haiqing_sign.2: Passive Skill - Lucky Star: a roll of 6 during the Dice Blessing immediately grants 6 Star Coins; when a Weak Marked target is killed, the Astrologer gains 3 Star Coins; if the killer is a player, that player gains a Fate's Guide.
astral_dice.guide.entry.hand_fan_big_chi: After using an active skill: gain a random effect card (excl. exclusive) and apply 1 Mark layer to all hostiles within range.
astral_dice.guide.entry.hand_fan_small_c: After using an active skill: apply 1 Mark layer to all hostiles within 16 blocks of you.
astral_dice.guide.entry.integration.2: Bountiful: bounty decrees can reward the mod's dice, star coins, star plates, cards, chips and signs (pure data-driven).
astral_dice.guide.entry.integration.3: Enigmatic Legacy+: Fate's Guide corrects the Cursed Ring's curses; the Guardian sign corrects Curse 4 during Burst; the Cursed Sword tugs at the Scroll of a Thousand Curses.
astral_dice.guide.entry.integration.4: Curse Mark: an enchantment woven into the mod's gameplay.
astral_dice.guide.entry.integration.name: Mod Integration
astral_dice.guide.entry.jasmine_sign.1: Active Skill - Energy Overload: for 2:00, movement speed +20%% and armor -30%%, plus one random effect: Resistance (2:00) or Strength (2:00).
astral_dice.guide.entry.jasmine_sign.2: Passive Skill - Motion Charge: every 300 meters moved, alternately gain +1 attack or +2 armor (attack cap 20, armor cap 40); using an Express Delivery card immediately reduces the active skill's max cooldown by 50%%.
astral_dice.guide.entry.komachi_sign.1: Active Skill - Ninjutsu Combo: this round's play count +1.
astral_dice.guide.entry.komachi_sign.2: Passive Skill - Replicator: every 3 effect cards used, copy the last used effect card to your inventory, reduce the active skill's cooldown by 30%% immediately, and gain +1 damage bonus for damage effect cards (cap 10, reset on unequip).
astral_dice.guide.entry.lulu_sign.1: Active Skill - Healing Slime: gain 3 healing points and instant healing yourself; apply instant healing to players/pets/rideables within range; apply Slowness (1:00) to hostiles within range.
astral_dice.guide.entry.lulu_sign.2: Passive Skill - Cell Division: when damaged, gain 1 healing point and reduce the active skill's cooldown by 10 seconds.
astral_dice.guide.entry.magic_quiver_chi: After using an effect card, dealing ranged/magic damage to a marked target applies 1 Mark layer and returns the first effect card used. Triggers at most once per 1:00.
After every 3 effect cards used, copy the last used effect card back to your inventory.
astral_dice.guide.entry.marker_sprayer_c: After dealing ranged or magic damage to a target, apply 1 Mark layer.
astral_dice.guide.entry.medkit_complete_: On Dice Blessing trigger, gain 3 healing points.
astral_dice.guide.entry.medkit_emergency: On Dice Blessing trigger, gain 1 healing point.
astral_dice.guide.entry.mimi_sign.1: Active Skill - Restock: recycle all cards in your inventory and receive N+1 random cards in return.
astral_dice.guide.entry.mimi_sign.2: Passive Skill - Recycle: when you gain a battle card through crafting or your active skill's returns, gain 1 Star Coin; while equipped, chip slots +1; every 25 battle cards returned by your active skill grants a random chip.
astral_dice.guide.entry.misaki_sign.1: Active Skill - Sakura Sky Slash: for 2:00, attack +4; dice value increased by your equipped dice's star level (1★+1, 2★+2, 3★+3); Meito damage floor increased by star level (1★+2, 2★+3, 3★+5). If Sword Energy reaches 3 layers, consume 2 to exchange for a Meito.
astral_dice.guide.entry.misaki_sign.2: Passive Skill - Sword Energy: gain 1 layer when a Dice Blessing triggers (max 3); each layer grants +1 attack, with an extra +2 at 3 layers; the Meito card's cost is reduced to 3.
astral_dice.guide.entry.misaki_sign.3: Enigmatic Legacy+ link: while wearing the Cursed Ring during Burst, correct Curse 4 — always deal full damage.
astral_dice.guide.entry.nancy_lu_sign.1: Active Skill - Remote Intrusion: enter full invisibility instantly (up to 30 seconds). Attacking a hostile mob or player immediately removes invisibility, consumes one random battle card from your main inventory, and grants attack equal to that card's cost ×2 for 2:00 (no bonus if no battle card is available).
astral_dice.guide.entry.nancy_lu_sign.2: Passive Skill - Network Firewall: immune to Ender Pearl teleport damage. After a Dice Blessing ends, if there are no hostiles within 6 blocks, gain +3 attack and a random battle card; otherwise gain +6 armor.
astral_dice.guide.entry.netherite_dice.1: Netherite die. The highest tier, with the most card and chip slots.
Effect card play count +1; while a damage effect card is active, ranged/magic damage to the target + the target's Mark layers.
astral_dice.guide.entry.padman_sign.1: Active Skill - Really Angry: reset the passive counter; this time, attack/defense values take their maximum.
astral_dice.guide.entry.padman_sign.2: Passive Skill - Indecisive: base attack/defense values shift from time to time (-2 to 4; defense converts to armor at 1 point = 2 armor); during the Dice Blessing, a roll of 6 ignores the target's defense; a roll of 1 makes your next roll 6.
astral_dice.guide.entry.papara_sign.1: Active Skill - Take a Bite: for 3:00, attacking heals half of the combat damage dealt; taking damage heals half of the damage received; regardless of your current HP, you count as both full HP and half HP.
astral_dice.guide.entry.papara_sign.2: Passive Skill - Cuteness Is Justice: at or below half max HP, attack +3 and armor +6.
astral_dice.guide.entry.parunan_sign.1: Active Skill - Cash Out: convert Starlight to Star Coins at a 2:1 rate, and randomly gain one of: Saturation (0:30), Luck (5:00), Hero of the Village (15:00).
astral_dice.guide.entry.parunan_sign.2: Passive Skill - Legendary Merchant: gain +1 Starlight from time to time (capped); triggering a Dice Blessing grants Starlight equal to the first roll ×2.
astral_dice.guide.entry.piercing_gun_chi: While a damage effect card is active, ranged/magic damage against hostile targets gains bonus damage equal to the target's defense points.
astral_dice.guide.entry.playstyles.2: Starlight: chips like the Flashlight, Eight-Sided Dice, ATM, Bank Cards and the Star Coin Hammer generate and spend it; the Merchant and Bulletin Board signs tie in.
astral_dice.guide.entry.playstyles.3: Healing: healing points form a single pool provided by Medkits, the Slime sign and the Buffer Shield; triggering a Blessing heals you for healing points × 2.
astral_dice.guide.entry.playstyles.4: Marks: build around mark stacks, combined with chips like the Magic Quiver for heavy spell damage.
astral_dice.guide.entry.playstyles.5: General chips such as Boxing Gloves, Speed Skates and Sandwiches directly buff your stats.
astral_dice.guide.entry.playstyles.6: Coordinate with teammates to pull off combos.
astral_dice.guide.entry.playstyles.7: Counterattack playstyle: with Counterattack layers, being hit by a hostile melee attack triggers a counter strike treated as your own melee attack — the highest held melee weapon's base damage + a 1d6 dice roll + attack-card bonus (auto-triggering the Dice Blessing and consuming card durability when you are not blessed) + all attack bonuses become the total damage dealt to the attacker, then 1 Counterattack layer is removed. Magic damage (evoker fangs, guardian beams, etc.) does not count as melee and does not trigger. The layer source will be added later.
astral_dice.guide.entry.playstyles.name: Playstyles
astral_dice.guide.entry.revenge_halberd_: While under any of these effects, attack +6: Weakness, Slowness, Mining Fatigue, Blindness, Darkness, Wind Charged, Weaving, Oozing, Infested, Blue Curse.
While under any of these effects, armor +12: Hunger, Nausea, Poison, Wither, Raid Omen, Trial Omen, Marked.
Each type triggers once and does not stack; the bonus vanishes the moment all matching effects are gone.
astral_dice.guide.entry.rin_sign.1: Active Skill - Living Page: gain a Living Page (two if you had none before).
astral_dice.guide.entry.rin_sign.2: Passive Skill - Investigation Findings: when you trigger an event or are affected by one, gain a Living Page; using one permanently increases its damage by +1 (reset on unequip).
astral_dice.guide.entry.sandwich_high_ch: Max health +8; while max HP exceeds 20, gain +1 attack per 4 extra HP.
astral_dice.guide.entry.adrenaline_high_: Adrenaline (High-Grade): while below half max HP, attack +8 and armor +16 (defense converts to armor at 1 point = 2 armor).
While the bonus is active, being attacked by a hostile rolls a 1d6 as your dice roll: on a roll of 5 or higher, a 50%% chance to dodge this damage.
astral_dice.guide.entry.satellite_chip.1: If you hold fewer than 6 Orbital Strikes, gain one every 1:00.
astral_dice.guide.entry.satellite_chip.2: After using an Orbital Strike, this round's play count +1 (once per 1:00).
astral_dice.guide.entry.satellite_chip.3: While an Orbital Strike is active, killing a hostile with ranged or magic damage grants a random effect card.
astral_dice.guide.entry.scope_chip.1: Attack +2; on hit, apply 1 Mark layer.
Dice Blessing: triggered by melee attacks while a dice is equipped; attack and defense clash during it, and its duration cannot be overwritten by the dice effect until it ends.
Marks: scopes, ninja stars, hand fans and more stack marks on targets; chips like the Magic Quiver resolve around marks.
Effect card states: Berserk, King Power, Unwavering and more; some are hidden-icon effects (e.g. Regeneration II from Fight Poison with Poison).
Charge: using the Charge card returns Full Power when the blessing ends.
Effect pending: while an effect is still active, a new round cannot start even if the cooldown has reset.
astral_dice.guide.entry.spell_damage.1: Spell damage comes from the damage effect cards: Monster Laser, Monster Brick, Orbital Strike, Directional Blast and the Living Page.
astral_dice.guide.entry.spell_damage.2: It benefits from damage bonuses, such as the Ninja sign passive 'Effect Card Damage Bonus': +1 for every 3 effect cards used (cap 10, reset on unequip).
astral_dice.guide.entry.spell_damage.3: The Magic Quiver applies 1 Mark layer and returns the first effect card used when you deal spell damage to a marked target.
astral_dice.guide.entry.star_coin.1: The mod's base currency, widely used in recipes and dice upgrading.
astral_dice.guide.entry.star_coin_bag.1: A pouch of 9 Star Coins; open it to retrieve them.
astral_dice.guide.entry.star_coin_hammer: Gain 5 Starlight on equip; if you hold more than 20 Star Coins, each Dice Blessing consumes 3 Star Coins and grants 30%% of your held Star Coins as attack (a Star Coin Bag counts as 9).
astral_dice.guide.entry.star_plate.1: A plate of solidified starlight for higher crafts. It appears in no recipe itself.
astral_dice.guide.entry.target_chip.1: Attack +1; after gaining a Dice Blessing, apply 1 Mark layer to a random hostile within range.
astral_dice.guide.entry.vitamin_pill_chi: When you obtain any card through crafting or other means, gain +1 healing point.
astral_dice.guide.landing: Welcome to Ren's Rulebook! Here you'll find the rules for dice, cards, signs and chips. May the god of the dice be with you!
astral_dice.guide.name: Ren's Rulebook
